interpretation.cohort_history: All 1024 queries were selected in the earlier audit without labels or structural/solver outcomes. Their outcomes have been studied before; this is not held-out evaluation.
interpretation.context: All original induced events in the incoming static distance-at-most-three vertex set, in [cutoff-1440, cutoff). No core trimming or tree projection.
interpretation.limits: Caps and timeouts are incomplete computation, not mathematical impossibility. Oracle timeouts/skips do not count as agreement.
interpretation.optimality_scope: Minimum deletion cost per attainable (W2,W3) pair on complete supported contexts only. No full-classifier prediction-change or fraud-effectiveness claim.
interpretation.policy_extension: 100%,95%,90% preservation and target floor(3*B3/4) reuse earlier formulas. Exact-target lookup and full profile checking are declared extensions motivated by the worked example. Unrestricted T=0 is omitted.
interpretation.rate_scope: Queries may share accounts and events. Report descriptive destination-account/minute query rates with explicit missing/incomplete denominators; not population fraud rates or independent trials.
interpretation.selection: Original complete cohort and hash order retained. No query omitted based on structural eligibility, counts, cost, or runtime.

study_label: Native Mac complete-context profile evaluation on the previously audited IBM cohort
